/ The Chapter of the Four Klingdoms]. /
In this lesson Mani takes as his text a saying of Jesus, and develops his own teaching from an analysis of the terminology used by the saviour. To share not only with the righteous elect, but even with catechumens, is a deed beyond any achieved by the greatest kingdoms of this world. It will bring an eternal reward.
It is noteable that this kephalaion speaks of the indwelling Holy Spirit, rather than the to be expected Light Mind (and see 143.24 - 32).
Once again the apostle speaks: There are f[our great kingdoms] / in the world.
